title: Sample onboarding
intro: A made-up practice, so the form can be built and checked before any client's template is loaded. Every field type and rule the real templates use is here.

sections.title: Before you start
sections.intro:
- Your answers save as you type. Stop any time and pick up where you left off.
- "Not sure yet" is always a fine answer, and nothing here commits you to anything.
- Your team gets its own link, which hides the questions marked Owner only. Copy it from the box below or from the menu, and please do not forward this one.
